# package ua

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/ua"
```

Package ua defines the structures, decoders and encoder for built-in data types described in Part 6 Section 5 Data encoding and for services in OPC UA Binary Protocol.

Default limits applied by [DecodeJSON](#func-decodejson) and [DecodeXML](#func-decodexml).

```go
const MaxBinaryNestingDepth = DefaultCodecMaxDepth
```

MaxBinaryNestingDepth bounds how deeply Variant, DataValue, DiagnosticInfo and ExtensionObject values may be nested inside each other in the UA Binary encoding. Each of these types counts as one level, whatever the path between them (a Variant holding a DataValue holding a Variant is three levels). Decoding or encoding a deeper value fails with \[StatusBadEncodingLimitsExceeded] (OPC UA Part 6 §5.2.2 lets a stack enforce encoding limits and report them with that status). The value matches DefaultCodecMaxDepth of the JSON and XML codecs.

```go
const XMLTypesNamespace = "http://opcfoundation.org/UA/2008/02/Types.xsd"
```

XMLTypesNamespace is the XML namespace of the OPC UA XML DataEncoding (Part 6 §5.3). NodeSet2 files use it for the content of \<Value> elements, usually with the prefix "uax".

### func DataTypeDisplayName

```go
func DataTypeDisplayName(dataTypeID *NodeID) string
```

DataTypeDisplayName returns a display string for a DataType NodeID. For well-known DataTypes in namespace 0 (e.g. Float, String, Boolean, UtcTime), it returns the standard name; otherwise it returns the NodeID string. Returns the empty string if dataTypeID is nil.

### func Decode

```go
func Decode(b []byte, v interface{}) (int, error)
```

### func DecodeJSON

```go
func DecodeJSON(data []byte, v interface{}, opts ...CodecOption) error
```

DecodeJSON decodes a document in the OPC UA JSON DataEncoding (Part 6 §5.4) into v, which must be a non-nil pointer to a value [EncodeJSON](#func-encodejson) accepts: \*int32, \*string, \*ua.Variant, \*ua.DataValue, \*ua.ReadRequest, \*\[]\*ua.NodeID, \*\*ua.NodeID, ...

The decoder accepts the Compact and Verbose encodings of OPC UA 1.05.04 and the reversible encoding of OPC UA 1.04 without being told which one it is given; the forms can even be mixed. The 1.04 non-reversible encoding drops type information and cannot be decoded.

Unknown members of a structure are ignored and missing members keep their default value. Duplicate members, values of the wrong JSON type, numbers outside of the range of the target type and documents nested deeper than the configured limit (see [WithMaxDepth](#func-withmaxdepth)) are errors. All errors wrap a \[StatusCode], usually \[StatusBadDecodingError].

### func DecodeXML

```go
func DecodeXML(data []byte, v interface{}, opts ...CodecOption) error
```

DecodeXML decodes an element in the OPC UA XML DataEncoding (Part 6 §5.3) into v, which must be a non-nil pointer as for [DecodeJSON](#func-decodejson).

The name of the outermost element is not checked, and elements are matched by their local name whatever their namespace prefix, so the content of a NodeSet2 \<Value> element can be handed over as it is:

	var v ua.Variant
	err := ua.DecodeXML([]byte(`<Value><uax:Int32>42</uax:Int32></Value>`), &v)

Both the bare form above and the form [EncodeXML](#func-encodexml) writes (\<Variant>\<Value>\<Int32>..) are accepted for a Variant.

Unknown child elements of a structure are ignored and missing ones keep their default value. An ExtensionObject whose type is not registered is kept with its body as an [XMLElement](#type-xmlelement). Documents nested deeper than the configured limit (see [WithMaxDepth](#func-withmaxdepth)) are rejected. DTDs are not processed and entities other than the five predefined ones are errors.

### func Encode

```go
func Encode(v interface{}) ([]byte, error)
```

### func EncodeJSON

```go
func EncodeJSON(v interface{}, opts ...CodecOption) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodeJSON encodes v in the OPC UA JSON DataEncoding (Part 6 §5.4).

v is a value of a built-in type (bool, int32, string, time.Time, \*NodeID, \*Variant, \*DataValue, \*ExtensionObject, ...), a pointer to a generated or registered structure, an enumeration, or a slice of any of these.

The default output is the Compact encoding of OPC UA 1.05.04, the form open62541 1.5 emits and accepts; see [WithJSONForm](#func-withjsonform) for the other forms. The result is unrelated to what encoding/json produces for the same value through the MarshalJSON methods of this package, which is a display format.

### func EncodeXML

```go
func EncodeXML(v interface{}, opts ...CodecOption) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodeXML encodes v in the OPC UA XML DataEncoding (Part 6 §5.3). It accepts the same values as [EncodeJSON](#func-encodejson).

The result is a single element named after the type of v (see [WithXMLRootName](#func-withxmlrootname)) that declares XMLTypesNamespace as its default namespace:

	<Variant xmlns="http://opcfoundation.org/UA/2008/02/Types.xsd"><Value><Int32>42</Int32></Value></Variant>

Structure fields holding a null value (a nil pointer, array or ByteString) are left out, as the schema allows; all other fields are written in the order of the structure definition. An ExtensionObject body is identified by the NodeId of the DefaultXml encoding node of its DataType.

### func RegisterDataTypeInfo

```go
func RegisterDataTypeInfo(v interface{}, info DataTypeInfo)
```

RegisterDataTypeInfo attaches JSON/XML metadata to a structure type that is (or will be) registered with [RegisterExtensionObject](#func-registerextensionobject). v is a pointer to the structure, exactly as passed to RegisterExtensionObject.

Without it a custom structure still round-trips through [EncodeJSON](#func-encodejson) and [EncodeXML](#func-encodexml): fields are named after the Go fields (or their \`opcua:"Name"\` struct tag) and the body is identified by the NodeId passed to RegisterExtensionObject. Registering the DataType NodeId is what makes the documents portable to other stacks.

The two registrations may come in either order and at any time, also while other goroutines encode and decode. A document can name the type by the NodeIds given here once the type is registered as an extension object as well; until then the decoders treat it as unknown.

TransportProfileForURL returns the transport profile of this library that serves an endpoint URL, by its scheme: opc.tcp, opc.wss, or opc.https (and https), with UA Binary. It returns "" for any other URL.

### type CodecOption

```go
type CodecOption func(*codecOptions)
```

CodecOption configures [EncodeJSON](#func-encodejson), [DecodeJSON](#func-decodejson), [EncodeXML](#func-encodexml) and [DecodeXML](#func-decodexml).

#### func WithIndent

```go
func WithIndent(indent string) CodecOption
```

WithIndent makes the encoders pretty-print with the given indentation.

#### func WithJSONForm

```go
func WithJSONForm(f JSONForm) CodecOption
```

WithJSONForm selects the JSON variant written by [EncodeJSON](#func-encodejson). The default is JSONCompact. [DecodeJSON](#func-decodejson) ignores it: it accepts the compact, verbose and legacy reversible forms without being told which one it is given.

#### func WithMaxArrayLength

```go
func WithMaxArrayLength(n int) CodecOption
```

WithMaxArrayLength overrides the maximum number of elements of an array in a Variant. The default is MaxVariantArrayLength, the limit of the binary decoder.

#### func WithMaxDepth

```go
func WithMaxDepth(n int) CodecOption
```

WithMaxDepth overrides DefaultCodecMaxDepth.

#### func WithNamespaceArray

```go
func WithNamespaceArray(uris []string) CodecOption
```

WithNamespaceArray provides the NamespaceArray of the server the values belong to (index 0 is "[http://opcfoundation.org/UA/](http://opcfoundation.org/UA/)").

With it the encoders write namespace URIs ("nsu=urn:x;i=1") instead of indexes ("ns=2;i=1") for NodeIds, ExpandedNodeIds and QualifiedNames, as Part 6 §5.1.12 asks for, and the decoders map the URIs back to indexes. Without it namespace indexes are written as they are.

#### func WithServerArray

```go
func WithServerArray(uris []string) CodecOption
```

WithServerArray provides the ServerArray used to map the ServerIndex of an ExpandedNodeId to a server URI ("svu=urn:srv;...") and back.

#### func WithXMLRootName

```go
func WithXMLRootName(name string) CodecOption
```

WithXMLRootName sets the name of the outermost element written by [EncodeXML](#func-encodexml). The default is the name of the type ("Int32", "Variant", "ReadRequest", ...).

#### func WithoutXMLNamespace

```go
func WithoutXMLNamespace() CodecOption
```

WithoutXMLNamespace makes [EncodeXML](#func-encodexml) omit the xmlns declaration of [http://opcfoundation.org/UA/2008/02/Types.xsd](http://opcfoundation.org/UA/2008/02/Types.xsd) on the outermost element, for documents that are embedded in an element which already declares it.

### type DataTypeInfo

```go
type DataTypeInfo struct {
	// Name is the name of the DataType. It is the element name of the
	// structure in an XML ExtensionObject body. It defaults to the name of
	// the Go type.
	Name string

	// DataTypeID is the NodeId of the DataType node. JSON identifies the
	// body of an ExtensionObject with it (UaTypeId).
	DataTypeID *NodeID

	// XMLEncodingID is the NodeId of the "Default XML" encoding node. XML
	// identifies the body of an ExtensionObject with it.
	XMLEncodingID *NodeID

	// JSONEncodingID is the NodeId of the "Default JSON" encoding node. It
	// is only accepted when decoding.
	JSONEncodingID *NodeID
}
```

DataTypeInfo describes how a structure registered with [RegisterExtensionObject](#func-registerextensionobject) appears in the JSON and XML DataEncodings. Every field is optional.

```go
type Diagnostic struct {

	// in the namespace NamespaceURI.
	SymbolicID   string
```

### type JSONForm

```go
type JSONForm int
```

JSONForm selects one of the JSON DataEncoding variants of Part 6 §5.4.

```go
const (
	// JSONCompact is the Compact encoding of OPC UA 1.05.04 and later. It is
	// the default and what open62541 1.5 reads and writes. Structure fields
	// holding their default value are omitted, enumerations are numbers and
	// a StatusCode carries no symbol.
	JSONCompact JSONForm = iota

	// JSONVerbose is the Verbose encoding of OPC UA 1.05.04 and later: every
	// structure field is written, enumerations are "Name_Value" strings and
	// a StatusCode carries its symbol.
	JSONVerbose

	// JSONLegacyReversible is the reversible encoding of OPC UA 1.04
	// (Part 6 Annex H in 1.05): NodeIds, QualifiedNames, Variants and
	// ExtensionObjects are JSON objects ({"IdType":..}, {"Type":..,"Body":..})
	// and a StatusCode is a number.
	JSONLegacyReversible

	// JSONLegacyNonReversible is the non-reversible encoding of OPC UA 1.04.
	// It drops type information (a Variant is just its value, a
	// LocalizedText just its text) and therefore cannot be decoded.
	JSONLegacyNonReversible
)
```

### type TypeID

```go
type TypeID byte
```

TypeID represents built-in type identifiers.

All OPC UA DataEncodings are based on rules that are defined for a standard set of built-in types. These built-in types are then used to construct structures, arrays and messages.

Specification: Part 6, 5.1.2.

```go
const (
	TypeIDNull            TypeID = 0 // not part of specification but some servers (e.g. Prosys) return it anyway
	TypeIDBoolean         TypeID = 1
	TypeIDSByte           TypeID = 2
	TypeIDByte            TypeID = 3
	TypeIDInt16           TypeID = 4
	TypeIDUint16          TypeID = 5
	TypeIDInt32           TypeID = 6
	TypeIDUint32          TypeID = 7
	TypeIDInt64           TypeID = 8
	TypeIDUint64          TypeID = 9
	TypeIDFloat           TypeID = 10
	TypeIDDouble          TypeID = 11
	TypeIDString          TypeID = 12
	TypeIDDateTime        TypeID = 13
	TypeIDGUID            TypeID = 14
	TypeIDByteString      TypeID = 15
	TypeIDXMLElement      TypeID = 16
	TypeIDNodeID          TypeID = 17
	TypeIDExpandedNodeID  TypeID = 18
	TypeIDStatusCode      TypeID = 19
	TypeIDQualifiedName   TypeID = 20
	TypeIDLocalizedText   TypeID = 21
	TypeIDExtensionObject TypeID = 22
	TypeIDDataValue       TypeID = 23
	TypeIDVariant         TypeID = 24
	TypeIDDiagnosticInfo  TypeID = 25
)
```

### type Variant

```go
type Variant struct {
	// mask contains the type and the array flags
	// bits 0:5: built-in type id 1-25
	// bit 6: array dimensions
	// bit 7: array values

	// arrayLength is the number of elements in the array.
	// This field is only present if the 'array values'
	// flag is set.
	//
	// Multi-dimensional arrays are encoded as a one-dimensional array and this
	// field specifies the total number of elements. The original array can be
	// reconstructed from the dimensions that are encoded after the value
	// field.

	// arrayDimensionsLength is the number of dimensions.
	// This field is only present if the 'array dimensions' flag
	// is set.

	// arrayDimensions is the size for each dimension.
	// This field is only present if the 'array dimensions' flag
	// is set.

}
```

MarshalJSON implements json.Marshaler for Variant. Scalars are encoded as {"type":"Int32","value":42}. Arrays are encoded as {"type":"Int32\[]","value":\[1,2,3]}. Null variants are encoded as {"type":"Null","value":null}.

### type WellKnownRole

```go
type WellKnownRole uint32
```

WellKnownRole identifies a standard OPC UA role. Values are the numeric NodeID of the role object in namespace 0.

```go
const (
	RoleAnonymous               WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleAnonymous
	RoleAuthenticatedUser       WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleAuthenticatedUser
	RoleObserver                WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleObserver
	RoleOperator                WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleOperator
	RoleSupervisor              WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleSupervisor
	RoleSecurityAdmin           WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleSecurityAdmin
	RoleConfigureAdmin          WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleConfigureAdmin
	RoleEngineer                WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleEngineer
	RoleTrustedApplication      WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleTrustedApplication
	RoleSecurityKeyServerAdmin  WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleSecurityKeyServerAdmin
	RoleSecurityKeyServerPush   WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleSecurityKeyServerPush
	RoleSecurityKeyServerAccess WellKnownRole = id.WellKnownRoleSecurityKeyServerAccess
)
```
